description: Defines data structures related to PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) information, including configurations, UCI (Uplink Control Information), and scheduler UL allocation details within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_information
classes.description: Contains details about a PUSCH resource allocation, including RNTI, configuration pointers, modulation, coding, DMRS, HARQ, and other transmission parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_info
classes.description: Houses UCI (Uplink Control Information) details such as HARQ-ACK and CSI reporting configurations.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_info::harq_info
classes.description: Contains HARQ-ACK bits and offset for UCI reporting.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_info::csi_info
classes.description: Contains CSI report configuration and bit counts for UCI.

classes.name: ocudu::ul_sched_info
classes.description: Represents scheduler uplink allocation info, including PUSCH configuration and optional UCI, along with decision context.

classes.name: ocudu::ul_sched_info::decision_context
classes.description: Houses logging/tracing info for UL scheduling, such as UE index, HARQ retransmissions, delays, and overhead PRBs.
